sources.entry: Infisical Community Edition - Platform for secrets, certificates, and privileged access management. (Source Code) MIT Docker/K8S/deb
Infisical | Secrets management platform for teams and infrastructure

summary.one_liner: Infisical is an open-source security platform for managing secrets, certificates, cryptographic keys, privileged access, and AI agent credentials.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a platform covering secrets management (dashboard, syncs to services like GitHub, Vercel and AWS, versioning, rotation, dynamic secrets, expiring secret sharing, a Kubernetes operator and an agent for injecting secrets), secret scanning of repositories and local files via the Infisical CLI with a pre-commit hook, and certificate management (internal and external CAs, ACME/EST/SCEP enrollment, discovery, syncs, code signing). It also includes a Key Management System for encrypt/decrypt/sign operations with KMIP support, a Privileged Access Management module with session recording and just-in-time access to databases and servers, and an Agent Vault that proxies AI agent API calls so real credentials are never handed to the agent. General platform features listed include SSO/LDAP/SCIM, machine auth methods, RBAC, audit logs, a network gateway, and client SDKs in several languages. Local setup is via Docker Compose.
use_cases: centralize and rotate application secrets across environments
scan git repositories for leaked credentials
issue and renew internal or public TLS certificates
manage database and server access with session recording
give AI agents API access without exposing real keys
share a secret through an expiring link
manage cryptographic keys via API or KMIP
how_to_run: Create an account in the web UI once the containers are running
notable: Covers secrets, certificates, KMS, PAM, and AI agent credential brokering in one platform
Agent Vault injects real credentials at the network proxy so AI agents never hold them
CLI scans for 140+ secret types and can install a pre-commit hook
Certificate lifecycle supports ACME, EST and SCEP enrollment plus CRL tracking
Session recording and just-in-time access for PAM
caveats: Premium enterprise features in the 'ee' directories require an Infisical license
Some features (such as certain enterprise offerings) are only in paid Infisical Cloud or Enterprise self-hosted tiers
Self-hosting setup is described only as a Docker Compose quickstart; the README points to separate docs for full deployment options
summary.license: MIT (with the exception of the ee directories, which are under a separate premium license)
keywords: share a secret with expiring link
